purpose: image manifest for Pokémon/form references, in two kinds: 128x128 menu sprites from Bulbagarden Archives (the dense-UI asset) and 512x512 HOME renders from PokéAPI's sprite repository (the hero asset)

fields.name: pokemon_asset_key
fields.description: Primary key; the composite `<pokemon_key>::<image_kind>`. pokemon_key alone is deliberately non-unique — each Pokémon carries one row per image kind

fields.name: image_kind
fields.description: One of: menu_sprite (Bulbagarden Archives, 128x128), home_render (PokéAPI sprite repository, 512x512)

fields.name: local_cache_path
fields.description: Path of the downloaded image file, relative to that image kind's extractor cache_dir (data/assets/bulbagarden/ for menu_sprite, data/assets/pokeapi_artwork/ for home_render) — not a release-time guarantee that the file still exists locally; releases/data/<version>/images/<image_kind>/ is the durable copy

fields.name: sha1
fields.description: SHA-1 checksum of the image file

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Resolved download URL for this image

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Upstream MediaWiki file title (menu_sprite) or PokéAPI form resource id (home_render)

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this row was published under
